description: Consumer Affairs Authority - Amended Extraordinary Gazette No. 2328/05 Dated 19.04.2023
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal/regulatory notification where the Consumer Affairs Authority is rescinding a previous order under the Consumer Affairs Authority Act, No. 9 of 2003 (Amended). It involves regulatory action (rescinding Order No. 86) and references specific legislation, fitting the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) for legal framework and regulatory matters.
